- psycopg: the connection pool now validates a connection on checkout, so one silently dropped by the network while idle (a firewall or load balancer closing it, a DB restart, ...) gets transparently replaced instead of being handed to the caller and failing with ``psycopg.OperationalErr

- Fix ``db_default`` on FK/O2O dropped during ``_init_relations`` (#2200)
- feat: add ``postgresql://`` scheme as alias for asyncpg (#2154)
- Added comprehensive EXPLAIN support for MySQL and PostgreSQL. (#2165)
- ``MigrationRecorder`` now uses parameterized queries; fixes MariaDB/MySQL rejecting ISO-8601 ``applied_at`` values. (#2132)
- fix: MSSQL connection left in busy state after insert (#2171)
- Type hint for ``TransactionContext`` now returns a ``TransactionalDBClient`` instead of a raw database conne

Install the wheel, run `jev4pg setup`, then install with `jev4pg --env-file admin.env migrate --sql-interface portable` from the generated profile. The portable SQL queue works through ordinary PostgreSQL objects and the existing worker, without copying extension files onto the server. [Setup and first query](https://github.com/Sheltercosmo/jev4pg/blob/v0.8.0/docs/EASY_SETUP.md).

Application 0.8.0 · PostgreSQL 17 · catalog schema 4 · SQL queue 0.1.0 · optional native 0.3.0 pr

Back up the database and stop the API and workers before running migration. Catalog version 4 preserves existing source rows and credentials, moves legacy metadata into `sdd_catalog`, and adds durable query jobs. A committed migration has no automatic downgrade.
The application uses Python by default. Native extension 0.2.0 remains an optional PostgreSQL 17 Linux preview; native maintained features and semantic write review are not included. Queue retention and admission limits require operational managemen

Validation: the complete test suite and PostgreSQL integration checks passed in Linux CI. The container smoke test covered HTTP and psql calls, batching, repeat migration, restart persistence and backup restoration. Deployment fixtures validate integration and do not measure model accuracy.

- A video's length is measured from what actually plays, not from the length
  its header announces: an edited header could slip a video of several
  minutes past `MAX_VIDEO_SECONDS`.
- The limit of 4 videos received at once holds for the whole server, however
  many times its code is loaded.
